full_details: You did not promise a journey that was not already set. The eighteenth remains the carrier, at the horses' pace. Anne said she would tell you plainly what cannot wait, and she told you that you have not looked at a real house. She did not name one, and she did not name a price. Richard came for the six pairs. You could not walk them. He took them, and he would not borrow your speech for the man's door. At night you did not name a house into the dark.
one_sentence: You stayed flat, made Anne a plainer bargain, and let Richard carry the skins.
title: Promised only the journey already set
